question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

The whys and wherefores
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Underlying reason​'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct meaning of the idiom *"The whys and wherefores"* is 1) **"Underlying reason".**
 
• The phrase **"the whys and wherefores" **is an idiom in English language that means the underlying reasons or causes of something.
 
• **It refers** to the explanations or justifications for an occurrence or action.
 
• **Underlying reason** - This refers to the fundamental cause or basis of something.(मूल कारण)

Therefore, the** correct answer** is: *'Underlying reason'.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Now, let's look at the meanings of all the options:
 
 
• **Summary - **In English, "summary" refers to a brief statement or account of the main points of something.(सारांश)
 
• **Interrogation - **In English, "interrogation" refers to the action of asking questions, especially formally or officially.(पूछताछ)
 
• **Minute observation - **This refers to detailed and careful observation.(सूक्ष्म निरीक्षण)
